services.titre: Ce que je fais pour vous
services.intro: Des missions concrètes, avec des livrables clairs et des constats classés par risque.

cartes.texte: Accès, changements, exploitation, contrôles automatiques et fiabilité des rapports, pour la direction et les commissaires aux comptes.
Analyse d'écart, appréciation des risques, Déclaration d'applicabilité et préparation à la certification.
Un SOC open source, sans licence coûteuse : détection, intégrité des fichiers, conformité CIS, vulnérabilités.
Audit IT pour auditeurs financiers, préparation aux certifications, sensibilisation des utilisateurs.

en.titre_onglet: Georges Alain Gracien CABO · IT audit and information security
en.titre: Information systems *under control*, with the evidence to prove it.
en.intro: A Dakar-based senior information systems auditor, I help banks, e-money issuers, telecom operators and companies strengthen their IT controls, prepare for ISO/IEC 27001 and monitor their security.

chiffres.texte: of IT audit in the same firm (EY Senegal, now Eritedge)
published in two languages on my campus

services.intro: Practical engagements with clear deliverables and findings ranked by risk.

cartes.texte: Access, change, operations, automated controls and report reliability, for management and statutory auditors.
Gap analysis, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability and certification readiness.
An open source SOC with no costly licenses: detection, file integrity, CIS compliance, vulnerabilities.
IT audit for financial auditors, certification preparation, user awareness.

demarche.titre: A clear method, from scoping to report

etapes.texte: Your processes, your critical applications and what feeds your financial statements.
Identify what can go wrong and prioritize by business impact.
Controls tested on documents and data, with documented evidence.
Findings ranked by risk, realistic recommendations and a tracked action plan.

campus.texte: Step-by-step courses in English and French: ISO 27001, Security+, CISA, CISM, CISSP, accounting, finance and 6 sectors, with explained quizzes and ITAC work programs.
